negative_findings.description: No standalone, clearly-labelled Pillar 3 / 'nyilvánosságra hozatal a kockázatkezelésről és a tőkemegfelelésről' landing page was located in this pass for K&H Bank Zrt., Erste Bank Hungary Zrt., UniCredit Bank Hungary Zrt., Raiffeisen Bank Zrt. or Gránit Bank Nyrt. Only CIB and legacy MKB/MBH Pillar 3 documents surfaced.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in hu using the exact statutory phrasing returned CIB, MKB and MNB guidance only; the other five banks' equivalents were not surfaced by search-engine results.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Pillar 3 reports are the annual anchor for capital/supervision signals; missing them for five of seven target banks leaves the capital-adequacy dimension of this cell under-covered.

negative_findings.description: No RSS/Atom or JSON feed was found for any of the seven banks' hirdetmény pages; all change notices appear to be HTML listings plus PDFs.
negative_findings.result_summary: Every discovered notice board (OTP, K&H, Erste, UniCredit, Raiffeisen, MBH, Gránit) is a rendered page or a document repository, several behind JS-driven frontends (e.g. gate.erstebank.hu documentId GUIDs).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection must be scrape-and-diff rather than feed-subscribe, raising fragility and cost, and making the archive pages (K&H, UniCredit, Raiffeisen) disproportionately valuable.

negative_findings.description: No bank-issued customer notice explicitly tied to the 2026 Hungarian payment-fraud/qvik regulatory package was found from OTP, K&H or the other target banks; only MNB press releases and press coverage surfaced.
negative_findings.result_summary: The hu query combining bank names with qvik / azonnali fizetés / 2026 jogszabályváltozás returned MNB, Portfolio and fintech.hu items, not bank hirdetmények.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell's core thesis is that hirdetmények are the earliest precise evidence of a rule biting; if such notices exist they are likely inside PDFs not indexed by search engines, implying collection must crawl the boards directly rather than rely on search discovery.

negative_findings.description: No URL in this slice was fetched or liveness-checked; all entries are search-derived. The Erste gate.erstebank.hu documentId links in particular are opaque GUIDs of unknown persistence.

negative_findings.why_it_matters: Downstream verification must treat any 403/timeout on these hosts as bot-defence rather than death, and must re-derive Erste document links from the hub page each run.

coverage_gaps.description: Pillar 3 / CRR Part 8 disclosure pages missing for K&H, Erste HU, UniCredit HU, Raiffeisen HU and Gránit.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Crawl each bank's 'felügyeleti dosszié' / 'befektetőknek' / 'rólunk > közzétételek' subtree directly and search on-site for 'nyilvánosságra hozatal', 'tőkemegfelelés', 'kockázatkezelés'; for foreign-owned subsidiaries also check the group site (erstegroup.com, kbc.com, unicreditgroup.eu, rbinternational.com) for HU-subsidiary annexes.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language versions of the hirdetmény/terms boards were not systematically located; most banks maintain /en/ mirrors that are usually thinner and lag the Hungarian originals.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Map the /en/ equivalents for each board and record the observed lag, so the pipeline always collects the hu original as authoritative and uses en only for translation support.

coverage_gaps.description: Archives were located for K&H, UniCredit and Raiffeisen but not confirmed for OTP, Erste, MBH or Gránit.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe each site for 'archív hirdetmény' / 'hatályon kívüli' / 'korábbi hirdetmények' sections; where absent, plan Wayback Machine backfill for the notice-board URLs.

coverage_gaps.description: Group-level subsidiaries and adjacent regulated entities of the seven (OTP Jelzálogbank, OTP Lakástakarék, K&H Biztosító, Erste Befektetési Zrt., Raiffeisen Befektetési Alapkezelő, Gránit Alapkezelő) were only partially mapped.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a full HU group entity map per parent and attach each entity's own hirdetmény/ÁSZF board, since regulation often bites at the subsidiary first.

coverage_gaps.description: Consultations (társadalmi egyeztetés) as reflected in bank disclosures were not evidenced; banks rarely publish consultation responses, and the Hungarian Banking Association (Magyar Bankszövetség) position papers were not scouted in this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add Magyar Bankszövetség (bankszovetseg.hu) and the banks' own press/newsroom pages as an adjacent cell or extension, since collective industry positions substitute for individual bank consultation responses in HU.

brief: Hungarian regulated-entity own disclosures are dense and highly structured, but almost entirely as HTML notice boards plus versioned PDFs — no feeds. Every one of the seven target banks runs a 'hirdetmény / kondíciós lista / ÁSZF' board, and several (MBH, legacy MKB) organise it as an MNB-mandated 'felügyeleti dosszié'; K&H, UniCredit and Raiffeisen additionally publish archives with explicit announcement-vs-effective date pairs, which is the highest-value signal in this cell for measuring statutory notice periods and regulatory lead times. Issuer-level regulated filings are best caught centrally at the MNB's OAM (kozzetetelek.mnb.hu) and BÉT's KIB store rather than bank-by-bank. The weakest spot is Pillar 3: only CIB and legacy MKB disclosure reports surfaced, so the capital/supervision leg of this cell needs a direct on-site crawl rather than search-engine discovery.
